chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Dharih al-Muharibi, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

Some people asked Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام while I was present, and he said: When the sun declines, then that is the time; nothing holds you back except your supererogatory prayer, whether you lengthen it or shorten it. Then some of the people said: We pray the first prayer when it reaches two feet, and the ʿasr prayer at four feet. So Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام said: Half of that is more beloved to me.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose decline determines the prayer time
key_terms.النِّصْفُ: half of the mentioned measure, indicating a preferred earlier timing
key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first prayer, referring here to zuhr
key_terms.زَالَتِ: declined from the meridian, marking the onset of zuhr time
key_terms.سُبْحَتُكَ: your supererogatory prayer performed before the obligation
key_terms.وَقْتٌ: the prescribed time for performing the prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time for zuhr and ʿasr begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the beginning time of the zuhr and ʿasr prayers. Imam Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام states that the time begins at the sun’s decline, and indicates preference for performing the prayers earlier than the practice mentioned by some people.
